article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

tasks.prompt: What main risk does the Office for Students identify?
options: AI can let students complete unsupervised assessments without demonstrating the intended learning
Universities have stopped offering practical exams
Students are refusing to use any digital tools
All remote exams have already been abolished
tasks.correct_answer: AI can let students complete unsupervised assessments without demonstrating the intended learning
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הרגולטור מזהיר שבינה מלאכותית מאפשרת להשלים מטלות לא מפוקחות ברמה גבוהה בלי להוכיח את הידע והמיומנויות הנבדקים.

tasks.prompt: Which assessment formats did the research describe as most effective against inappropriate AI use?
options: Coursework and remote essays
Group projects and handouts
Closed-book and practical exams
Multiple-choice quizzes completed at home
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחקר קבע שמבחנים בחומר סגור ומבחנים מעשיים הם צורות ההערכה היעילות ביותר בהקשר זה.

tasks.prompt: Who contributed views to the OfS and Advance HE research?
options: Only university vice-chancellors
244 higher-education staff and 91 students
More than 10,000 recent graduates
Representatives from exactly 93 universities
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחקר מבוסס על דעות של 244 אנשי סגל ו־91 סטודנטים מלפחות 127 אוניברסיטאות.

tasks.prompt: What does it mean for an assessment to “maintain its validity”?
options: It remains available online for several years
It produces identical answers from all students
It can be marked entirely by software
It still measures the knowledge and skills it was designed to test
tasks.correct_answer: It still measures the knowledge and skills it was designed to test
tasks.explanation_hebrew: validity בהערכה פירושה שהמטלה אכן מודדת את הידע והמיומנויות שלשמם נבנתה.

tasks.prompt: What possible penalties are proposed for universities that fail OfS quality standards?
options: A ban on charging increased fees or caps on student numbers
Closure of every remote-learning course
Removal of all access to AI research funding
Compulsory replacement of every essay with an oral exam
tasks.correct_answer: A ban on charging increased fees or caps on student numbers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי ההצעות, מוסדות שלא יעמדו בתקני האיכות עלולים לאבד את האפשרות לגבות שכר לימוד מוגדל או לקבל מגבלה על מספר הסטודנטים.

tasks.prompt: What does “fit for purpose” mean when staff discuss university assessments?
options: Easy enough to finish in a few minutes
Popular with every student
Suitable and effective for their intended job
Designed only for supervised examination halls
tasks.correct_answer: Suitable and effective for their intended job
tasks.explanation_hebrew: fit for purpose פירושו מתאים ויעיל למטרה שלשמה נועד; כאן השאלה היא האם המטלה באמת בודקת למידה.

tasks.prompt: Why does the report say undetectable AI use creates a “generational risk” for higher education?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הפגיעה המצטברת בלמידה, באמינות הציונים וביכולת המוסדות להעריך סטודנטים.
expected_points: Students may receive grades without developing or demonstrating the intended knowledge
Institutions may no longer be able to assess learning reliably
Qualifications and assessment results could lose credibility over time

tasks.prompt: Summarise the contrasting views of the regulator, Universities UK and the National Union of Students on how assessment should change.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג בקצרה את עמדת כל אחד משלושת הגופים בלי לטשטש את ההבדלים ביניהם.
expected_points: The OfS calls for much greater use of AI-free assessment and replacement of invalid tasks
Universities UK says institutions are already adapting with exams, presentations, vivas and controlled AI use
Universities UK argues different subjects need flexible approaches
The NUS says traditional methods are outdated and change should be co-designed with students

tasks.prompt: What does the phrase “polarised atmosphere” reveal about student attitudes to AI?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר חלוקה חדה בין משתמשים בבינה מלאכותית לבין נמנעים ממנה ואת הסיבה העקרונית האפשרית.
expected_points: Students are divided into opposing groups rather than sharing one approach
Some use AI in their assessment work
Others deliberately avoid it, including for environmental or ethical reasons

tasks.prompt: Propose two article-supported ways a university could redesign an assessment while still testing the intended learning.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לבחור שני פתרונות שמופיעים בכתבה ולהסביר כיצד כל אחד משפר את אמינות ההערכה.
expected_points: Options include in-person closed-book exams, practical exams, presentations or vivas
Process-based assessment can show how work was developed
AI may be integrated in a controlled and clearly permitted way
The redesign should require students to demonstrate the target knowledge and skills
